name: aiku-assistant
description: Lightweight local desktop file assistant powered by Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with P0 filesystem security

scripts.island: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -STA -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File desktop/windows-island/island.ps1
scripts.ui: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -STA -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File desktop/windows-island/island.ps1
scripts.desktop: npm run build && cargo run --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
